news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Decode the Controversial Dialogue in The Paradise
news.summary: Hero Nani and director Srikanth Odela recently spoke about a heavily criticized line in their film The Paradise involving Kayadu Lohar’s character. The director clarified that the line was meant to highlight childhood acting talent, but the necessary backstory was trimmed to shorten the runtime. Nani noted that losing such setup scenes often causes well-intended dialogue to be misunderstood by viewers.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Flaunts Bold Vintage Style in Latest Photoshoot
news.summary: Actor Taapsee Pannu has shared a new series of photographs showcasing a striking retro aesthetic featuring voluminous curls and a floral mini dress. Despite facing a challenging box office run this year with her previous outings, she continues filming for Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?.

news.title: Sambarala Yeti Gattu to Stick to Its Original Sankranti Schedule
news.summary: Makers of the Sai Durga Tej starrer Sambarala Yeti Gattu have confirmed that their mass action film will proceed with its planned Sankranti release. Despite initial speculation about potential date shifts to avoid a clash with Chiranjeevi's upcoming project, the producer confirmed that post-production is nearly complete and the team remains locked into the festive race.

news.title: Hombale Films Acquires Southern Rights for Box Office Blockbuster Hanuman Ansh
news.summary: Following its massive commercial success in the Hindi market, the low-budget hit Hanuman Ansh is heading to southern languages. Hombale Films has secured the regional dubbing rights to distribute the biographical drama centered on the early life of Neem Karoli Baba.

news.title: NTR Set to Revive Dragon Filming in Mumbai Soon
news.summary: Leading actor NTR is gearing up to return to the sets of his upcoming film Dragon in Mumbai starting October 10th. After recovering from a shoulder injury that pushed his original shooting timeline, the star will participate in a heavy-duty two-week action schedule. Directed by Prashanth Neel, the movie features a notable cast including Rukmini Vasanth, Anil Kapoor, and Biju Menon with music by Ravi Basrur.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi's January 12 Vidudala Nears Completion
news.summary: Director Anil Ravipudi is speeding through the final stages of his upcoming project January 12 Vidudala, keeping strictly to schedule. The production will shift to Ooty in early October for a fresh leg of filming, followed by overseas song shoots before wrapping entirely by mid-November. The movie features a prominent ensemble cast including Venkatesh, Kalyanram, Keerthy Suresh, and Krithi Shetty, with music scored by GV Prakash Kumar.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Maintains Strong Box Office Momentum
news.summary: Nani's latest cinematic outing, The Paradise, continues to pull solid numbers at the box office following a record-breaking opening weekend. Family audiences have turned out in droves alongside general moviegoers, driving impressive bookings into Sunday. Directed by Srikanth Odela and produced by Sudhakar Cherukuri, the film has delivered a powerful showcase of the actor's major box office pull.

news.title: Chakkora Theatrical Trailer Unveils a Mysterious Romance
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird, launched by Aakash Jagannadh in Hyderabad, highlights a unique blend of romance, family drama, and unexpected suspense. Directed by debutant Manga Srinivas, the musical entertainer follows a carefree youth whose world turns upside down when the heroine mysteriously vanishes. Featuring music by Prince Henry, the film is slated for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9.

news.title: First Look and Stills Unveiled for Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana
news.summary: The much-awaited mythological epic Ramayana, directed by Nitesh Tiwari, has revealed new promotional material showing Ranbir Kapoor as Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman. Additionally, the makers introduced the first look of Yash as the antagonist Ravana, showcasing his regal and commanding presence. Backed by Prime Focus Studios, the two-part film is slated for theatrical releases during Diwali 2026 and Diwali 2027.

news.title: Chakkora Trailer Introduces a Blend of Romance and Mystery
news.summary: Debut director Manga Srinivas's upcoming film Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird has released its official trailer following an event in Hyderabad. The narrative follows a carefree protagonist whose world turns upside down when his love interest suddenly vanishes, leading to an emotional search. The movie is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Continues Strong Box Office Run Over Weekend
news.summary: Despite a risky mid-week premiere and mixed initial critical responses, Nani's starrer The Paradise has managed an impressive box office streak. Directed by Srikanth Odela, the movie grossed 136 crores worldwide in its first three days and saw a surge in collections across Telugu states. The film is also performing strongly in overseas territories like the UK, Australia, and the US.

news.title: NTR to Resume Shooting for Prashanth Neel's Dragon in Mumbai
news.summary: Actor NTR is set to return to film sets following his recovery from a shoulder surgery that kept him out of action for nearly two months. He will join Anil Kapoor in Mumbai starting October 10 for a 15-day schedule featuring high-octane action sequences. Directed by Prashanth Neel and produced by Mythri Movie Makers, the pan-India project is currently eyeing a June 2027 release.

news.title: Nani's High-Budget Drama The Paradise Gears Up For Crucial Monday Box Office Trial
news.summary: Nani's big-budget film The Paradise has experienced a mixed reception from audiences and critics despite pulling in solid numbers over its opening weekend. Trade estimates indicate the movie crossed significant box-office milestones by the weekend, though it still faces a steep climb to reach its ultimate target. With no major competing films releasing next week, the upcoming Monday collections will serve as a decisive factor for its theatrical run.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Drop For Upcoming Two-Part Epic Ramayana
news.summary: The makers of the massive cinematic adaptation Ramayana have released striking new promotional posters ahead of its scheduled Diwali releases in 2026 and 2027. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the project features Yash in a regal and imposing avatar as Ravana, alongside a contrasting second poster highlighting the divine trio of Ram, Lakshmana, and Sita. The film boasts music by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer, aiming to bring the classic epic to a global audience.

news.title: Nagarjuna's Milestone Project King100 To Release Character Teaser For Tabu
news.summary: Nagarjuna Akkineni's milestone film King100 is preparing to unveil a special promotional video introducing Tabu's character to audiences. The movie reunites Nagarjuna and Tabu on screen years after their memorable 1990s hit Ninne Pelladutha, with Tabu starring alongside other female leads like Sushmita Bhat. Directed by Ra Karthik and backed by Annapurna Studios and Manam Enterprises, the film is locked for a December 24, 2026 theatrical release.

news.title: Makers Of Vijay Deverakonda Starrer Ranabaali Announce Promotional Docu-Series
news.summary: Director Rahul Sankrityan's upcoming historical drama Ranabaali, starring Vijay Deverakonda, is set to release a four-part promotional documentary series titled Ranabaali: Never Forget. Drawing from two years of historical research into British suppression in Rayalaseema, the series features the lead actor, Rashmika Mandanna, and the director discussing the project's background. Produced by Mythri Movie Makers, the film is slated to arrive in cinemas on October 16, 2026.

news.title: BRS Leader KTR Applauds The Paradise After Theater Screening
news.summary: BRS Working President KTR caught a screening of Nani's latest release The Paradise at Hyderabad's Sudarshan Theatre alongside various public figures. He praised the movie for its authentic depiction of Telangana's culture, language, and the poignant struggles of an oppressed community standing up for their rights.

news.title: Industry Buzz Points to Stronger OTT Valuations for Rashmika Mandanna Over Sai Pallavi
news.summary: Industry reports indicate that streaming platforms are willing to offer higher valuations for female-centric projects headlined by Rashmika Mandanna compared to Sai Pallavi. Rashmika's involvement in major pan-Indian box office successes and her vast social media presence are cited as key drivers behind her strong digital market standing.

news.title: The Paradise Registers Steady Ticket Sales on BookMyShow on Day Three
news.summary: Despite encountering polarized feedback, Nani's action vehicle The Paradise continued to hold firm with robust digital ticket sales. The movie recorded 252K purchases on BookMyShow on its third day, nearly matching its second-day tally and pushing past the Rs. 115 crore gross milestone achieved in its first two days.

news.title: Shocking Exit: Wildcard Contestant Grabs Cash Prize and Leaves Bigg Boss Telugu 10
news.summary: In a surprising turn of events on Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10, newly entered wildcard contestant Mithilesh chose to take home a 15 lakh rupee cash offer and exit the house. Having spent just a day in the reality show, he defended his choice by stating that the house dynamics made winning impossible for him. This marks an unprecedented departure in the history of the television program.

news.title: Nani Expresses Joy Over The Paradise Becoming a Long-Distance Runner at Box Office
news.summary: Actor Nani spoke at the Hyderabad media interaction for The Paradise, highlighting how the movie successfully flipped initial negative reactions into glowing praise. He credited the relentless dedication of the entire crew, assistant directors, and technicians for the project's stellar run. Furthermore, he praised veteran actor Mohan Babu and his co-stars for their remarkable contributions.

news.title: Mohan Babu Calls His Character in The Paradise the Deadliest of His Five-Decade Career
news.summary: Veteran actor Mohan Babu revealed that his role in Nani's newly released film The Paradise is the most ferocious character he has portrayed in his 50-year cinematic journey. Speaking at a press meet in Hyderabad, he lauded director Srikanth Odela's storytelling vision and dedication. He also praised producer Sudhakar for backing the film without financial compromises.

news.title: Nani Highlights The Paradise's Rare Box Office Turnaround From Negative to Positive
news.summary: Natural Star Nani addressed the press during a promotional event for The Paradise, noting a unique shift in audience reception that progressed from early negativity to strong positivity with every screening. Directed by Srikanth Odela and backed by producer Sudhakar Cherukuri, the movie features an ensemble cast including Mohan Babu, Raghav Juyal, Sonali Kulkarni, and Kayadu Lohar.

news.title: Fresh Visuals of Ranbir Kapoor and Yash Unveiled for Ramayana
news.summary: Fresh promotional posters for Nitesh Tiwari's grand mythological venture Ramayana have been revealed, showcasing Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash in striking avatars. Backed by producer Namit Malhotra and featuring visual effects by DNEG, the big-budget spectacle is scheduled for a worldwide IMAX release in Diwali 2026.
